Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office (bid_number BPM044557) is procuring 30 units of Dell Latitude 5550 laptops and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Dock WD22TB4 docks (SI# CC7802). Bids must be submitted electronically through the eMMA portal before the due date of June 10, 2024, 2:00 PM EDT; bids received by email, fax, U.S. Mail, or hand delivery will not be accepted. The contract will be awarded under the 2015 Master Contract 060B5400007 and requires a fixed‑price proposal valid for thirty days, with invoices sent to STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us within 10 days of delivery. Deliveries must occur within 45 days of award, and sellers must provide a 3‑year extended Dell Limited Hardware Warranty, a Dell Limited Hardware Warranty Extended for all machines purchased, as well as the MERCURY CONTENT INFORMATION and Proposal Affidavit documents. For questions, contact Tamaira Hawkins at 410‑260‑7533 or thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us; no pre‑bid meeting information is provided, and bid bond requirements are not specified.
